name: Create-Auto-leave-From-Encashment-v1
script:
# This script runs after submitting Leave Encashment
# It generates a Leave Application if the employee is going on vacation
# and saves the leave application in a custom link field

if doc.custom_is_employee_going_on_vacation:

    # Validate dates
    if not doc.custom_vacation_from or not doc.custom_vacation_end:
        frappe.throw("Vacation From and Vacation End dates are required.")

    if doc.custom_vacation_end <= doc.custom_vacation_from:
        frappe.throw("Vacation End Date must be greater than Vacation From Date.")

    # Prevent duplicate Leave Application for same period
    exists = frappe.db.exists("Leave Application", {
        "employee": doc.employee,
        "from_date": doc.custom_vacation_from,
        "to_date": doc.custom_vacation_end,
        "leave_type": "Annual Leave Days",
        "docstatus": 1
    })

    if exists:
        frappe.msgprint(f"Leave Application {exists} already exists for this period.")
        # Save existing leave in custom link field
        # doc.db_set("custom_generated_leave_app", exists)
    else:
        # Create Leave Application
        leave_app = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Leave Application",
            "employee": doc.employee,
            "leave_type": "Annual Leave Days",  # Shadow LOP leave type
            "from_date": doc.custom_vacation_from,
            "to_date": doc.custom_vacation_end,
            "status": "Approved",
            "description": f"Annual Leave. Settlement Ref: {doc.name}",
            "leave_approver": frappe.session.user
        })
        leave_app.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        leave_app.submit()

        # Save generated leave application in the custom link field
        doc.db_set("custom_leave_application_no", leave_app.name)

        frappe.msgprint(f"Leave Application {leave_app.name} created and submitted.")
